newsitem.title: USA: Torchmark Corp Q1 oper shr rises.
newsitem.headline: Torchmark Corp Q1 oper shr rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Q1 insurance underwriting income increased 12 percent to $75 million.
At March 31, 1997, annualized life premium in force was $952 million, a seven percent increase from a year earlier.
Total Q1 revenue, excluding investment realized gains and losses, was $568 million, up four percent from same period in 1996.
Life premium revenue was up six percent to $222 million in the first quarter. Health premium revenue was flat at $188 million. Financial services revenue increased nine percent to $48 million.
In 1997 Q1, an investment net realized loss of $11 million was taken to offset taxable gains, as compared with a net realized gain of $5 million for the first quarter of 1996.
Net investment income was $104 million for the first three months of 1997, up four percent compared with a year ago.
Return on equity at March 31, 1997, (excluding the effect of SFAS 115, discontinued operations and realized gains and losses) was 20.7 percent vs 19.8 percent at March 31, 1996.
